root_cause.text: ext4_xattr_inode_dec_ref_all() acquires a buffer head via ext4_get_inode_loc() but never releases it with brelse(), causing a buffer head reference leak when block_csum is false (the code path that was altered by the faulty commit).
root_cause.evidence: The CVE and patch description state: "ext4_xattr_inode_dec_ref_all() calls ext4_get_inode_loc() to get iloc.bh, but never releases it with brelse()." The patch adds `brelse(iloc.bh);` at the end of the function and initializes `iloc.bh = NULL` to safely handle cases where the buffer was not acquired.
